title: add annotated release metrics + onboarding snapshot artifact
author: Sofia Reyes
description: Introduce a lightweight onboarding snapshot and an annotated release-metrics artifact that gets produced during model onboarding and attached to model release changelogs. Motivation: teams need compact, machine-readable perf / footprint summaries alongside model metadata so product owners and infra can quickly triage regressions and make cost/latency tradeoffs. This PR implements: 1) a snapshot generator that runs a compact suite (latency p50/p95, token throughput, peak vram estimate, warm/cold KV-cache delta) against pinned micro-benchmarks; 2) an 'annotated_release_metrics.json' artifact schema (compact list of metrics + provenance + commit/tag) that is emitted by the onboard pipeline; 3) a release hook that bundles the annotated metric into model changelogs and exposes human-friendly blurbs used by release notes generation; 4) guardrails and delta thresholds that fail onboarding when key regressions are detected (configurable via registry.yaml). Single-string description required by PR format.
commits: 4a3f2b9: introduce snapshot runner and minimal benchmark harness
b2c1e44: hook snapshot into onboarding pipeline and attach to release bundle
c93f7a1: tests and docs for release annotation and delta thresholds
f08d2a3: CI flakiness fixes / increase benchmark stability by lowering batch sizes
release_notes: Add compact onboarding snapshot artifact (annotated_release_metrics.json) to model releases.
Release hook now includes human-friendly changelog blurbs summarizing perf/footprint deltas.
Onboard pipeline will fail when configurable regression thresholds are exceeded (opt-in behavior).
review_comments: Priya Nair (2024-05-03): Please document the exact benchmark inputs used for the snapshot and add a short rationale for the chosen micro-benchmarks.
Sofia Reyes (2024-05-03): Added docs section with reproducible inputs and a rationale; the harness uses representative token lengths for chat vs. single-turn generation.
Ethan Cole (2024-05-04): Requested adding a provenance field (git commit + runner image hash) to the artifact — this is required for auditing.
Sofia Reyes (2024-05-04): Added provenance and lightweight CI validation to ensure the runner image is stamped into artifacts.
Marco Schmidt (2024-05-06): Noted intermittent benchmark flakiness on older GPU CI workers; suggested lowering batch size and adding retry logic to the snapshot runner.
Sofia Reyes (2024-05-07): Implemented retry + reduced batch defaults; reran CI to stabilize tests — all green now.
ci_notes: Initial CI failed on bench steps due to memory spikes on legacy runners; subsequent commit lowers default batch sizes and adds one-shot retries for noisy measurements. Final CI run passed all checks.
notes_for_release_manager: The annotated_release_metrics.json is emitted for every onboarded model when onboarding is run with --emit-metrics. For existing models we recommend a backfill run before a major release; the changelog hook will only attach metrics when the artifact is present.
risk_and_mitigation: Risk: noisy micro-benchmarks could generate false positives and block onboarding. Mitigation: conservative default thresholds, retries, optional opt-in enforcement, and an allowlist for high-variance models defined in registry.yaml.
testing_summary: Unit tests cover serializer+schema validation; integration test runs snapshot against a small set of reference models; CI includes a cheap smoke benchmark stage and a non-blocking extended benchmark that runs on scheduled runners.
